visual.general_description: Black-and-white swimlane timeline of the hospital course against hospital day, showing rehabilitation, antibiotics, neck brace, dialysis, bladder management, oxygen and evaluations.
visual.detailed_description: Black-and-white line diagram with a numbered horizontal axis labelled HD at the bottom, a left vertical axis, and a horizontal divider line separating an upper Rehabilitation course lane from the lower Hospital course lanes. A box labelled Symptom onset sits at the top with a vertical line running down through both sections to an arrow at the tick printed 20. Rehabilitation course lane: a long outlined bar labelled Active comprehensive rehabilitation runs from the left edge to just before the tick printed 44, a raised box labelled Bed side rehabilitation follows up to about the tick printed 52, and a second long bar labelled Active comprehensive rehabilitation runs from there to the right end near 365. IV antibiotics lane: a bar labelled Vancomycin begins at the tick printed 27 and ends at the tick printed 56; a box labelled Moxifloxacin sits above it from about the tick printed 44 to 56; a box labelled Piperacillin/Tazobactam begins at 56 and ends well to the right of 56, left of the axis break, with no end value printed. Neck brace lane: a bar labelled Philadelphia neck brace begins at the tick printed 27 and runs to the right end near 365. Hospital course lane: a long bar labelled Hemodialysis spans the whole width from the left edge to the right end, with a short box labelled CRRT between about the ticks printed 44 and 52. Bladder management lane: a bar labelled Foley catheter insertion begins just left of the tick printed 41 and runs to the right end near 365. Oxygen supplement lane: one outlined bar begins just left of the tick printed 41 with the labels Nasal, High flow and then, further right, Nasal to the right end near 365. Evaluation lane: boxes labelled CT, EMG, MRI and CT with arrows to the ticks printed 27, 41, 44 and 52; tick labels 56 and 365 are also printed, with a wavy double-line break in the axis before 365.

visual.general_description: Three gray-scale cross-sectional neck images labelled (a), (b) and (c): CT, MRI and a follow-up CT of the cervical spine.
visual.detailed_description: Three side-by-side gray-scale images separated by thin white gaps, each with a letter in its upper-left corner. (a) is a rotated bone-bright neck scan with the cervical vertebrae running diagonally and black wedges at its corners. (b) is a mostly dark MRI-style image of the neck with a diagonal spine, a bright linear band along the canal and mixed bright and dark signal in the lower vertebrae. (c) is a wider bone-bright side view of the head and neck with the nasal cavity, mouth, jaw and cervical spine, a gray soft-tissue band in front of the lower vertebrae and uneven vertebral contours. No names, dates or numbers are printed.

panels.detailed_description: Gray-scale neck scan in a side view with bright white bone, labelled (a) in the upper-left corner. The image is rotated, leaving black wedge-shaped areas at the lower left and upper right. A column of cervical vertebrae runs diagonally with the bony posterior elements toward the right; the lower vertebral bodies look mottled with uneven density. A small thin-lined square outline sits near the lower-right edge of the image. No other printed text, names or numbers are visible.
